channel.desc: Cody died from poisoning caused by a toxic metal, and his former roommate was charged with murder, but his family thinks there may be more to the story; Gloria was overwhelmed with grief and anger when her beloved dog, Champ, went missing, and her heartbreak deepened when her friend Joseph failed a lie detector test regarding Champ's death.
